events.verdict: Hunter (ATL) cleanly blocks the jump shot attempt by Williams (CHI) and any ensuing contact is incidental.
Hunter (ATL) is the last play to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Williams (CHI) contests Capela's (ATL) dunk attempt and the contact with Capela's head is marginal.
LaVine (CHI) briefly places an arm at Johnson's (ATL) side before immediately correcting and legally contesting the shot attempt.
Carter (CHI) moves laterally into Young's (ATL) path and initiates body contact that affects his SQBR.
Vucevic (CHI) initiates contact with Hunter's (ATL) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Vucevic (CHI) is assessed an unsportsmanlike technical foul.
Daniels (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position during LaVine's (CHI) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Carter (CHI) commits a take foul on Young (ATL). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Hunter (ATL) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Williams (CHI).
